title: CORE
content:
MoM page with CORE, attendees:

Other stakeholders:

General

No major alterations needed for the release flow; specific items discussed, listed below.

Azure Uploads and Akamai

  • Azure uploads take long time, bottleneck. (This is also identified in other teams/products).

    • Daniel initiated Azure functions work intended to speed it up

      • Perhaps a session can be booked to look at it further

    • DevOps team to investigate if something else can be done; optimizations

  • Move to Akamai

    • Questions regarding SSO, script execution, etc

  • Testing with Aka headers should be further discussed, investigated, and tested out

  • Option 1, tuning, vs moving to Akamai should be discussed further

Azure: Intermittent Errors in Artifacts

  • Team to spread knowledge to all team members that:

    • If the problem happens, contact DevOps team directly

      • SR towards MS will be created. The sooner the better (logs are rotated)

SonarQube

As with other teams, problems regarding rules. Team CORE will first check what, and if, they can change on their own. Otherwise discuss with DevOps again. DevOps needs to further the rules strategy, it also needs be discussed in developers functional meetings.

Repository Strategy - Monorepo or Not

No direct advises: it should be easy to work with the repository/repositories

  • CORE to ping in Slack devops channel to discuss further

    • Lessons learned in other teams: Turborepo, etc

Scripts and Shared Repository

  • CORE to port scripts to Node.js or other suitable frontend language

    • Enough competencies should exist; however, the language must be suitable for the operations

    • If scripts are deemed valuable for other teams they should be added to common repository

  • Homesmart has scripts that will be added to the shared repository, name of repository,inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-frontend-release-tools (github.com) and shared via

Reusable Workflows

Historically a problem (common to reusable workflows in general) with versioning

  • Change branch to working branch → change back to tag

    • This is solved by the team - no further actions needed

Upgrade Dependency Updater

New version (https://github.com/inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-dependency-updater/pull/8 ) was released on behalf of Skytta team. CORE’s still on V1. Check if upgrade is feasible.

Monitoring: Sentry / New Relic

As team is a product “provider” - developing packages for other teams, there is no urgent need for Sentry

A plugin, however, would be valuable for the team to get an overview

  • Sentry expertise can be provided if needed, and when team feels ready for this task

DORA Metrics

We checked repository tagging - this is perfectly OK. Then this task was created, which we need to take action on later: PE-156370cd962b-65cc-357d-b445-58d5af5f9e17System JIRA

Other

  • Developers functional meeting, Thursdays: meeting forwarded.

  • DevOps: Discuss with Anders how onboarding to those meetings are done
